d:
Jharkhand men khali pare bord, nigam aur aayog ke gathan ko lekar sattarurh indiya gathbandhan men siyasi sargarmi tej ho gaee hai. rajy satta men shamil sahyogi dalon ke bich hissedari ka saval uthne laga hai. jharkhand rajad ne gathbandhan men pichhli bar apni andekhi par narajgi jatate hue is bar sammanajnak hissedari ki mang ki hai.
